messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate on inference-runtime pods (prod-us-west-2). 90% of restarts in the last 5m are SIGSEGV. Affected deployment: inference-runtime-engine v2.3.1. pods: inference-runtime-*/prod.

incident-bot: summary: crashloopBackOff x 14, avg restartCount 7, cpu 60%, mem 78%. Pager: Samir.

Samir: on it. seeing the alert. @Tao can you check node/oom/kernels?

Tao: jumping in. pulling logs now. first quick grep shows repeated: 
```
[2026-03-15T18:02:13Z] runtime-engine: fatal error: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f9d3e0baf23 sp 0x7ffd3a7c3b10 error 4
[2026-03-15T18:02:13Z] signal: SIGSEGV (core dumped)
```
Looks like a null-deref in fused-kernel path (custom kernel). happening ~every pod on node ip-10-2-45-11.

Jess: confirmed. kubectl get pods -n prod | grep inference-runtime shows 14 pods crashlooping. restartCount: 6-12. Crash only on nodes with GPU driver 515.x — other nodes (driver 520.x) are unaffected.

Kelsey: note: we rolled v2.3.1 last night which enabled fused-kernel optimizations for TRT. suspect regression in fused path.

Samir: immediate mitigations: 1) stop routing traffic to affected pods 2) try non-fused fallback (env flag) 3) roll back if needed.

Tao: doing quick mitigation — cordon node ip-10-2-45-11, drain with --ignore-daemonsets to push pods elsewhere. If other nodes pick up they hit same segfault, we fallback to env var.

Jess: running command: 
```
kubectl cordon ip-10-2-45-11 -n prod
kubectl drain ip-10-2-45-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n prod
```
Drain started, pods terminating.

deploy-bot: Deployment inference-runtime-engine@prod v2.3.1 currently at 24 replicas; rollout paused: false. Previous revision v2.3.0 available.

Tao: quick test — set DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 on a single replica to confirm.

Jess: patching one pod via temporary env on deployment: 
```
kubectl set env deployment/inference-runtime-engine DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=true -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime-engine -n prod
```
One pod came up healthy after restart, no segfault seen in logs for 2m.

Kelsey: that suggests fused-kernel path in v2.3.1 is the culprit. plan: 1) set DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=true globally, 2) roll new image v2.3.0 back if env var causes perf regression.

Samir: agree. Kelsey please coordinate with releases. Also need to keep customers informed: CSE, support, and status page. Impact: approx 12% of requests failing 500s across US-west region, and some elevated latency while pods churned.

Kelsey: creating rollback/mitigation runbook now. immediate steps executed: 
- Applied env DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=true to deployment (all replicas)
- Rolling restart triggered
- Autoscaler paused for 10m to prevent rapid scale loops
- Opened support ticket INC-8921 for affected customers

Jess: commands applied: 
```
kubectl set env deployment/inference-runtime-engine DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=true -n prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-runtime-engine -n prod
kubectl annotate deployment/inference-runtime-engine mitigation/active=true -n prod
```
All pods stabilized within ~90s. crashloop count down to 0.

Tao: monitoring logs and node telemetry. GPU driver mismatch correlation holds: nodes with 515.x still hit segfault after env change in small repro, so env change is more reliable than node changes.

Samir: good. next: schedule a rollback to v2.3.0 if perf delta > 8% in 30m, otherwise keep env-disable until patch. Notify customers on status page and via CSE.

deploy-bot: rollback candidate v2.3.0 (image sha: sha256:abcd1234) ready. To perform rollback run: 
```
kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-runtime-engine --to-revision=3 -n prod
```

Kelsey: I'm posting to status.redwood.ai: "Service degradation in prod-us-west-2 affecting inference runtime. We have applied a mitigation and ongoing monitoring. No data loss suspected. Teams are working on root cause and patching."

Jess: quick perf check: p99 token latency rose from 120ms -> 320ms during churn; after mitigation p99 ~150ms. error rate back down to baseline.

Tao: creating a short repro job hitting fused-kernel path on a 515 driver node to capture core dump and stack trace. attaching to bug: RH-3145.

Samir: handoff plan — I'll stay on incident until 19:30 PT, then hand to night on-call. Kelsey, please include the following in the handoff note: 
- mitigation applied (DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=true)
- rollback candidate v2.3.0 available (sha abcd1234)
- nodes affected: list (ip-10-2-45-11, ip-10-2-46-09)
- customer impact: ~12% requests 500 for 18m window, CSE contacted 3 customers flagged high-volume.

Kelsey: copying handoff into #oncall-handoff and creating follow-up ticket (ENG-5402) for a proper patch.

Samir: thanks all. any short-term postmortem notes: collect gcore from crashed pod, driver versions, container args, and the exact fused-kernel flags enabled.

incident-bot: Incident updated. Severity: Sev2 -> mitigation in place -> monitoring.

Samir: handing off to @Tao for overnight monitoring. please escalate to me if error rate rises >3% over baseline or if rollback is executed.

Tao: acknowledged. will monitor logs, set alert for repeat SIGSEGV events. leaving trace links here: https://telemetry.redwood.ai/trace/ENG-5402/1766234567

Kelsey: Creating customer comms draft for CSE: "We experienced a runtime crashloop in US-WEST due to a fused kernel regression in v2.3.1. We applied a mitigation flag, service restored. We will release a patch or rollback within the next 24 hours."

Jess: adding to postmortem checklist: kernel oops stack, core dump analysis, test matrix for driver versions, release gating for fused features.

Samir: closing thread for now. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
